# Abhijit Borade

> Personal website of Abhijit Borade, Director of Technology at Angular Minds.

## About

Abhijit Borade is a technology leader based in Pune, India. His work spans engineering, architecture, products, teams, AI, and emerging technology.

He has over a decade of experience in software engineering and technology leadership. He is interested in engineering judgment, technical trade-offs, leadership, AI, software, and technology.

## Personal interests

Beyond work, Abhijit is interested in gaming, music, solo motorcycle rides, road trips, cars, travel, gadgets, software, and technical rabbit holes.
